title: Resonance chains should appear in conscious but not unconscious states

statements.text: If shared resonance underlies the combination of consciousness, measurable correlates of consciousness should show resonance chains in conscious states and not in unconscious ones, with minimally conscious states under drugs or sleep as a boundary case. The authors grant that the axioms and mechanisms could be wrong.
statements.falsification_criteria: Resonance chains of the kind the conjecture names appearing equally in unconscious states, or absent from conscious ones.

sources.quote: if shared resonance underpins the combination of consciousness (Conjecture 1), then various resonance chains should be observed in conscious but not unconscious states
we could, of course, be wrong about our axioms and posited mechanisms for the combination of consciousness!
